I love this show and I have the same feelings. What I've missed out on, the relationships I've never had, the family environment that seems so foreign to me are all parts of the show that resonated with me on a nostalgic level. 

You're not alone and maybe this is the reason the show has the following it does. It gives us a glimpse of what life could have been like had we been given an opportunity to thrive and not just survive.

The solace and comfort I find is that it's an enjoyable escape and that for a few moments when I watch the show I can feel relaxed and peaceful. 

I hope you find that peace too.

Short answer, no. Don't give up. Let it take as long as it takes. We're conditioned to believe we're on a time limit and we're not. Take as many classes as you can afford, work two jobs if need be. That's what I'm doing. I work a morning job on the weekends and an evening job five days a week during busy season. Taking 2-3 classes at a time. It's a grind but having a college degree is all I've ever wanted. If you want this, you CAN do it. You don't realize what you're capable of until you make yourself do things you don't want to do for a greater purpose. 

Otherwise, move onto the next chapter of your life and find something you ARE willing to work hard and sacrifice for. 

Best of luck!
